scores.note: 'inexpensive' is the best pick and comes first. Option 6 'cheaply made' changes the sense to poor quality (0). Option 9 'budget-conscious' describes people, not bags (0). Option 10 'wallet-friendly' is too casual/marketing for an essay (0). 'budget-friendly' is also marketing-ish; 'cost-effective' and 'economical' shift slightly toward value.
